tldr: Headlines worldwide frame this as a straightforward policy proposal — the Trump administration permanently codifying a $103,265 H-1B visa fee. Indian outlets stand apart by recentering every headline on the disproportionate impact on Indian workers and aspirants, while Japan Times and Geo News foreground the court-defeat context that explains why the administration chose a new regulatory vehicle.

bottom_line: At the headline layer the story is almost universally framed as a routine policy proposal, with the key divergence being Indian outlets' consistent shift to an impact-on-Indians lens and two outlets explicitly naming the court defeat the new rule is designed to work around.
